mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, PRODUCT_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL, ORDER_NO, STATE_TYPE, TRADE_ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_UNIT, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_COST, BUY_COST, MEMO FROM TR_ORDER_DTL WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL = #{commonTradeOrderSerial} ORDER BY SERIAL_NUMBER

SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, PRODUCT_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL, ORDER_NO, STATE_TYPE, TRADE_ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_UNIT, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_COST, BUY_COST, MEMO FROM TR_ORDER_DTL WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
SELECT DISTINCT STATE_TYPE FROM TR_ORDER_DTL WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL = #{commonTradeOrderSerial}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_ORDER_DTL ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, PRODUCT_SERIAL, COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL, ORDER_NO, STATE_TYPE, TRADE_ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_UNIT, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_COST, BUY_COST, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{productBit}, #{productSerial}, #{commonTradeOrderSerial}, #{orderNo}, '10', #{tradeItemType}, #{itemUnit}, NOW(), #{orderCost}, #{buyCost}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_ORDER_DTL SET STATE_TYPE = #{stateType}, MODIFY_DATE = NOW(), MODIFY_IP = #{modifyIp} WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND COMMON_TRADE_ORDER_SERIAL = #{commonTradeOrderSerial}
UPDATE TR_ORDER_DTL SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
